The pull request adds file previews and a settings-path helper. The preview’s containment check permits access outside the selected home directory and should be fixed before merge.

## Important
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — `is_relative_to()` checks lexical containment without resolving `..` or symlinks, so `preview("/tmp/home", "../outside.txt")` passes the check and reads `/tmp/outside.txt` when that file exists; an in-home symlink can likewise escape — Callers can preview readable files outside the selected home directory.
